crossRefs.note: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

translations.web: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
translations.bsb: and He saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins.
translations.kjv: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
translations.asv: And he saw a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
